content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have revealed quite a bit of information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new version of the HomePod mini, a security camera, a new-generation Siri remote for the Apple TV 4K, and the long-awaited HomePad product.

After digging deep into the code, it also seems to have provided important clues to help us understand the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito from Engadget discovered that, although the HomePad will most likely run some version of tvOS, it may operate more like a larger Apple Watch.

The code also shows a nice privacy feature: Widgets will only display your personal information when your iPhone is detected nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions—one with a speaker base, possibly looking similar to a HomePod, and the other designed for wall-mounted installation.

In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned above, several unknown devices were also mentioned. Personally, I'm really hoping a smart doorbell is among them. Is there any Apple home product that particularly excites you? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
